settings.heading: Three things every other case gets wrong
settings.subheading: Not adjectives. Three measurements, each one taken in a lab and published in full.
settings.proof_heading: Drop height before the phone was damaged
settings.proof_footnote: Independent lab, 26 drops per unit onto concrete, MIL-STD-810G 516.6.

settings.problem: It cracks on the first real drop
settings.body: Slim usually means solid plastic corners that pass the shock straight into the frame. These corners are a honeycomb of collapsing air cells — they crush, absorb, and spring back. 26 drops onto concrete from 12 feet, no phone damage.

settings.problem: The magnet lets go when you need it
settings.body: "MagSafe compatible" is a sticker, not a spec. We publish pull force. Eighteen N52 magnets in a full ring hold 1,400 g, so your phone stays on the vent mount over a speed bump — and still charges at the full Qi2 25W.

settings.problem: Clear turns yellow by month four
settings.body: Cheap TPU oxidises under UV and skin oil — that's why your last clear case looked like an old fingernail. This back is UV-stable polycarbonate with a bonded top coat: no measurable colour shift after the equivalent of three years outdoors.

settings.question: Will it fit my exact model?
settings.answer: Each case is cut from that phone's own CAD file — one mould per model, not a universal shell. Pick your model and the fit is exact: no gaps at the camera, no rattle, no covered mic.

settings.question: Does wireless charging still work?
settings.answer: Yes, at full speed. The magnet ring is aligned to the MagSafe spec and passes Qi2 25W, MagSafe, and standard Qi. You don't need to take the case off to charge, mount, or use a wallet.

settings.question: Is it really going to stay clear?
settings.answer: The back is UV-stable polycarbonate with a bonded top coat, not soft TPU. In accelerated testing equivalent to three years outdoors we measured no perceptible colour shift. If yours yellows inside two years, the warranty covers it.

settings.question: How thick does it actually feel?
settings.answer: 2.8 mm across the back and 3.4 mm at the rail, adding about 24 g — thinner than a stack of three credit cards. It still slides into a pocket, and the grip texture means it doesn't slip out of your hand.

settings.question: What if I ordered the wrong model?
settings.answer: Message support with your order number and we'll send the right one with a prepaid label for the first. No restocking fee, and you don't pay shipping twice.

settings.question: Why is a multi-pack cheaper per case?
settings.answer: Same case, one shipment. Packing and shipping two or three together costs us less than three separate orders, so the saving goes to you. Most people keep one on the phone and one in a bag or car.
